cd /private/var/folders/kp/vdv61pd97vd0x29b257r8h7h0000gn/T/barcode-sdvx2d63; cat > /private/tmp/claude-501/-private-var-folders-kp-vdv61pd97vd0x29b257r8h7h0000gn-T-barcode-sdvx2d63/63bd8efc-0048-4cf3-887a-81eb58846437/scratchpad/b.py <<'EOF'
import subprocess,numpy as np
from PIL import Image
b=np.asarray(Image.open('barcode.png').convert('RGB')).astype(float).mean(0)
def rs(a,n=100):
    idx=np.linspace(0,len(a)-1,n).astype(int); return a[idx]
B=rs(b)
for L in 'ABCDEFGHIJ':
    raw=subprocess.run(['ffmpeg','-v','quiet','-i',f'videos/{L}.mp4','-vf','fps=1,scale=16:9','-f','rawvideo','-pix_fmt','rgb24','-'],capture_output=True).stdout
    f=np.frombuffer(raw,np.uint8).reshape(-1,9*16,3).mean(1)
    V=rs(f)
    print(L,np.abs(V-B).mean(), np.corrcoef(V.mean(1),B.mean(1))[0,1])
EOF
